sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale
of shares of our Common Stock offered by the Selling Stockholder. We may receive up to $29,800,324 in aggregate gross proceeds from sales
of shares of our Common Stock to the Selling Stockholder pursuant to the Purchase Agreement after the date of this Prospectus. However,

sections.excerpt:

of risk. Investors should carefully consider the following Risk Factors before deciding whether to invest in the Company. Additional risks

sections.excerpt:

future for our operations. We have never paid any dividends on our Common Stock and do not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the
